text: Android: lists and items keyed by a phone-local id, unique per account and server id (B1b)

Merged as three cherry-picked commits (HEAD 36b846d), full gate green. Review: migrated rows keep their old id as local id (so last-opened, mutes and posted deep links stay valid); stub lists are built before the item join; the merge looks rows up per (account, server id); the 422 cannot_delete_expense_list path resets clocks instead of hard-deleting so items keep a valid list. 18 mutations caught. Deferred to B2: a list shared by two signed-in accounts appears twice on the overview until sections per account exist.
